integrity: Exact analytic proof with independently implemented complex-generator and symbolic tests; no independent external audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional, symmetric direction choice, strictly positive rates, complete Poisson restart of both position and internal mode. The result concerns stationary position marginals and does not assert first-passage or dynamic ordering. Known stationary spatial aliasing at v²=D(b+r) is excluded from the novelty claim; off-balance comparison against unindexed broader theory remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Sharp likelihood-ratio ordering and exact Laplace design by mixed-phase resetting
